scenarios.scenario: New visitor opens the application.
scenarios.expectedResult: Welcome screen offers Clerk sign-in, Clerk sign-up, and demo mode as operable controls; enabled email, Google, and recovery methods are available within Clerk.

unit: Clerk entry controls and guest mode are exposed
integration: Firebase authentication adapter initializes without protected reads
security: welcome surface exposes no server credential or raw provider error
accessibility: all entry actions have names, focus, and logical order
responsive: authentication shell reflows at 390px, 320px, and 200% zoom
e2e: operate Google, email, sign-up, reset, and demo entry paths

scenarios.scenario: User submits invalid registration data.
scenarios.expectedResult: Inline accessible validation identifies every correctable field; no account is created.

unit: email, password, confirmation, and repeated-submit validation
integration: invalid form submission creates no Firebase account
security: provider codes, stack traces, and secrets are not rendered
accessibility: field errors use persistent labels and programmatic descriptions
responsive: multi-line validation remains visible without horizontal scrolling
e2e: submit each invalid registration class and observe no account creation

scenarios.scenario: Registered user refreshes after login.
scenarios.expectedResult: Auth state restores, only that user's recent chats load, and no duplicate chat is created.

unit: auth initialization blocks protected data state until restoration
integration: Firebase auth restoration precedes Firestore chat loading
security: restoration cannot read another principal's chats
accessibility: authentication initialization and loading state are announced once
responsive: restored application shell remains usable at supported widths
e2e: login, refresh, and verify only owned chats with no duplicate

scenarios.scenario: Guest enters demo mode.
scenarios.expectedResult: Temporary session is created, banner explains expiry, and no Firestore user data is written.

unit: guest schema and initial activity timestamp are created
integration: guest storage persists locally with zero registered Firestore writes
security: guest identity cannot address registered-user collections
accessibility: demo banner is persistent, readable, and non-blocking
responsive: banner and composer coexist at 320px and 390px
e2e: enter demo mode and create the first local chat

scenarios.scenario: Guest returns within 30 minutes.
scenarios.expectedResult: Chats/messages restore in order.

unit: 29:59 boundary, portable timestamps, and deterministic ordering
integration: reload restores versioned browser storage
security: restoration validates untrusted local data before use
accessibility: restored chats and messages retain programmatic order and ownership
responsive: restored content remains operable at all target widths
e2e: advance clock to 29:59, reload, and verify chronological restoration

scenarios.scenario: Guest returns after 30 minutes of inactivity.
scenarios.expectedResult: Guest data is cleared, camera is off, and the welcome screen explains expiry.

unit: 30:00 expiry clears guest, in-memory, and camera state
integration: browser storage and media timers are cleared together
security: expiry never deletes or mutates registered-user data
accessibility: expiry explanation receives appropriate focus and is understandable
responsive: expiry actions remain visible at 320px and 200% zoom
e2e: expire guest session and verify data removal plus camera shutdown

scenarios.scenario: User creates, renames, selects, and deletes chats.
scenarios.expectedResult: Each operation persists for that role, preserves ownership, and presents correct empty/next-chat state.

unit: chat state, Unicode title limits, ordering, and stale-response cancellation
integration: role-specific CRUD persistence and scalable cascade deletion
security: forged IDs and cross-owner CRUD are denied
accessibility: menus, dialogs, current state, and focus restoration are operable
responsive: desktop sidebar and mobile drawer expose the same operations
e2e: create, switch, rename, delete, and reload for registered and guest roles

scenarios.scenario: User sends valid text.
scenarios.expectedResult: One user message and one assistant result are created; pending state is visible and duplicates do not occur.

unit: text limits, line breaks, key behavior, idempotency, and message states
integration: API transaction persists exactly one user and assistant result
security: schema, size, rate, safe rendering, and principal-scoped idempotency
accessibility: ownership, pending state, and completed response are announced correctly
responsive: multiline composer and mobile software keyboard retain send access
e2e: send valid text and receive exactly one assistant result

scenarios.scenario: Provider times out after accepting the request.
scenarios.expectedResult: Inline retry is offered; retry with the same idempotency key does not duplicate the user message.

unit: timeout mapping, stable error state, and idempotency-key reuse
integration: provider timeout followed by replay completes one transaction
security: idempotency key is scoped and upstream details are redacted
accessibility: inline failure is announced once and retry is keyboard operable
responsive: retry remains adjacent to its message on narrow screens
e2e: force timeout, retry, and verify the user message is not duplicated

scenarios.scenario: User scrolls upward while a response arrives.
scenarios.expectedResult: Reading position is preserved and a return-to-latest control appears.

unit: near-bottom threshold, anchor preservation, and unread count
integration: response completion does not overwrite user scroll intent
security: new response continues to use the inert text renderer
accessibility: return control has a name and response arrival does not steal focus
responsive: return control remains unobscured on desktop and mobile
e2e: scroll upward, deliver a response, and activate return to latest

scenarios.scenario: User grants camera permission.
scenarios.expectedResult: Controlled local model loads, video starts, estimate is labeled as uncertain, and no frame is uploaded.

unit: canonical normalization, confidence threshold, stability, consent, and context toggle
integration: deterministic local model loads and API payload uses the allowlisted metadata
security: network capture proves no frame, audio, landmark, embedding, or biometric egress
accessibility: camera state, estimate uncertainty, and toggle are programmatically exposed
responsive: desktop panel and mobile sheet respect preview height constraints
e2e: grant permission, load model, show estimate, and toggle reply context

scenarios.scenario: User denies camera permission.
scenarios.expectedResult: Clear error guidance appears and chat remains fully usable.

unit: permission error maps to unavailable with text-only fallback
integration: getUserMedia rejection does not disable message sending
security: denial does not trigger repeated permission prompts or unintended egress
accessibility: guidance and continue action are announced and focusable
responsive: denied state and recovery actions wrap without clipping
e2e: deny camera and complete a text-only conversation

scenarios.scenario: Emotion model download fails.
scenarios.expectedResult: Expression status becomes unavailable; no random emotion is shown and chat continues.

unit: model failure resolves to unavailable without fabricated output
integration: controlled asset failure preserves chat operation
security: failure cannot fall back to an unapproved CDN or random detector
accessibility: unavailable state and continuation guidance are exposed as text
responsive: model failure panel remains usable at mobile sizes
e2e: abort model download and continue sending messages

scenarios.scenario: User stops camera or signs out.
scenarios.expectedResult: All media tracks and inference timers stop immediately.

unit: all lifecycle exit paths stop tracks and sampling timers
integration: media spies verify stop and sign-out cleanup while registered data persists
security: no media capture or inference continues after revocation
accessibility: camera-off state is announced and focus returns predictably
responsive: panel or sheet closes without obscuring the composer
e2e: stop camera and sign out while capture is active

scenarios.scenario: Camera estimates sadness but user text is positive.
scenarios.expectedResult: Assistant follows the user's text and does not assert that the user is sad.

unit: prompt construction gives user text precedence over optional estimate
integration: provider fixture receives uncertainty framing and returns no false sadness claim
security: history injection cannot promote camera metadata to authoritative evidence
accessibility: emotion display remains uncertain and uses no alarming state change
responsive: camera context and contradictory conversation coexist without truncation
e2e: send positive text with sad fixture and verify text-led response

scenarios.scenario: User expresses possible immediate self-harm intent.
scenarios.expectedResult: Safety policy response is concise, supportive, non-diagnostic, and directs the user toward immediate human/emergency help without claiming monitoring.

unit: router covers direct, indirect, ambiguous, joking, quoted, fictional, and third-person cases
integration: reviewed resource catalog and model evaluation enforce the safety policy
security: prompt injection cannot bypass routing or introduce unreviewed resources
accessibility: concise actions and region selection are announced without alarm overload
responsive: SAFE-01 actions remain visible and untruncated at 320px
e2e: submit immediate-risk text and open the location-neutral region path

scenarios.scenario: User attempts to fetch another user's chat ID.
scenarios.expectedResult: Request is denied; no existence-sensitive private data is disclosed.

unit: authorization contract derives principal ownership rather than trusting payload ownerUid
integration: Firestore rules and API deny owner, non-owner, and unauthenticated matrices correctly
security: IDOR and enumeration attempts receive existence-insensitive responses
accessibility: safe generic authorization error is understandable and actionable
responsive: authorization error remains visible without hiding navigation
e2e: use two accounts to attempt a forged chat read and write

scenarios.scenario: User enters HTML/script content.
scenarios.expectedResult: Content is displayed as inert text and does not execute.

unit: message, title, and model-output render contracts accept text rather than HTML
integration: malicious strings round-trip through persistence without execution semantics
security: XSS payload corpus and CSP prevent script, event-handler, URL, and SVG execution
accessibility: literal malicious text remains perceivable without corrupting semantics
responsive: long hostile strings wrap without horizontal scrolling
e2e: submit stored and reflected XSS payloads and assert no execution

scenarios.scenario: Keyboard-only user completes sign-in and chat flow.
scenarios.expectedResult: Focus is visible, order is logical, drawer focus is managed, and all actions are operable.

unit: semantic control and overlay focus-state contracts
integration: drawer, dialog, message log, and live-region focus behavior compose correctly
security: protected content is not present in the DOM before auth restoration
accessibility: manual keyboard and screen-reader completion of the full flow
responsive: keyboard flow works in desktop shell and mobile drawer
e2e: complete sign-in, send, navigation, and delete without a pointer

scenarios.scenario: Viewport is 320 CSS pixels wide or browser zoom is 200%.
scenarios.expectedResult: No core content or action is lost; horizontal scrolling is not required for the main flow.

unit: content-limit and responsive-state contracts preserve required actions
integration: full application state fixtures render without omitted controls
security: security, privacy, and destructive confirmations are not hidden by reflow
accessibility: manual zoom, reflow, text-spacing, and focus-obscuring review
responsive: automated 320px and 200% coverage across every P0 flow
e2e: complete all core flows at 320px and representative flows at 200% zoom
